memory_candidates.content: Before writing any parser for a markdown field convention in this repo's plan corpus, measure the live spelling distribution first -- the documented form is not always the dominant one. Measured for the per-phase dependency field: '**Depends on**:' occurs 4907 times repo-wide while '**Depends on:**' (colon inside the bold) occurs 296 times, and plan-format.md's own field definition uses the MINORITY spelling. A parser matching only the documented form silently reads 296 real occurrences as absent. The same survey also found values that are not phase numbers at all ('Phase 3 (directory skeleton must exist)', 'Tasks 593 (shared utilities), 594 (skill base)' -- task numbers, not phase numbers), so such a parser needs all-or-nothing token validation against PHASE_NUMBER_TOKEN_ERE with a conservative documented-default fallback, never best-effort partial parsing.
